static int modulo(int j, int m) {

static long long powm(long long a, long long b, long long m) {
    long long an = 1;
    long long c = a;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) an = (an * c) % m;
        c = (c * c) % m;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return an;
}

// Fast input reader (similar to Java's Reader)
static char __buffer[1 << 20];
static int __pos = 0;
static int __len = 0;

static inline int getchar_fast() {
    if (__pos == __len) {
        __pos = 0;
        __len = (int)fread(__buffer, 1, sizeof(__buffer), stdin);
        if (__len == 0) return EOF;
    }
    return __buffer[__pos++];
}

static inline int ni() {
    int x = 0, f = 1;
    char c = getchar_fast();
    while (c < '0' || c > '9') {
        if (c == '-') f = -1;
        c = getchar_fast();
    }
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
        x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
        c = getchar_fast();
    }
    return x * f;
}

static inline long long nl() {
    long long x = 0, f = 1;
    char c = getchar_fast();
    while (c < '0' || c > '9') {
        if (c == '-') f = -1;
        c = getchar_fast();
    }
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
        x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
        c = getchar_fast();
    }
    return x * f;
}

static inline double nd() {
    double x = 0.0;
    double f = 1.0;
    char c = getchar_fast();
    while (c < '0' || c > '9') {
        if (c == '-') f = -1.0;
        c = getchar_fast();
    }
    bool point = false;
    double divisor = 1.0;
    while ((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '.') {
        if (c == '.') {
            point = true;
        } else {
            int digit = c - '0';
            if (point) {
                divisor *= 10.0;
                x = x * 10.0 + digit;
            } else {
                x = x * 10.0 + digit;
            }
        }
        c = getchar_fast();
    }
    return f * x / divisor;
}

static inline char next_char() {
    char c = getchar_fast();
    while (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t') c = getchar_fast();
    return c;
}

static inline string ns() {
    string s;
    char c = getchar_fast();
    while (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t') c = getchar_fast();
    while (c != ' ' && c != '\n' && c != '\r' && c != '\t' && c != EOF) {
        s.push_back(c);
        c = getchar_fast();
    }
    return s;
}

static int* nia(int n) {
    int* a = new int[n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) a[i] = ni();
    return a;
}

static long long* nla(int n) {
    long long* a = new long long[n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) a[i] = nl();
    return a;
}

static string* nsa(int n) {
    string* a = new string[n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) a[i] = ns();
    return a;
}

static double* nda(int n) {
    double* a = new double[n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) a[i] = nd();
    return a;
}

static void sop(const string& s) {
    printf("%s\n", s.c_str());
}

static void sop(int x) {
    printf("%d\n", x);
}

static void sop(long long x) {
    printf("%lld\n", x);
}

static void sop(double x) {
    printf("%.10f\n", x);

    int odd = 0, even = 0;
    int l = 0, j = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0)
            even++;
        else
            odd++;
        if (even == odd) {
            dp[j] = abs(arr[i+1] - arr[i]);
            j++;
        }
    }
    sort(dp, dp + j);
    for (int i = 1; i < j; ++i) {
        dp[i] += dp[i-1];
        if (dp[i] <= b)
            l = i;
    }
    sop(l);
    delete[] arr;
    delete[] dp;
    return 0;
}
